write_up: You come across as a staff software engineer who has grown from cloud storage into payments infrastructure at Brightline. A recruiter has good reason to move this forward: the ledger redesign, idempotency framework and fraud pipeline show substantial distributed systems work. The main question is how big the current platform and team are.

The idempotency line is a strong model: it connects adoption across payment services to the duplicate-charge incidents it eliminated. Your progression at Brightline is easy to follow, and your recent stack is right where a recruiter needs it.

Let's start with the current role. Add the team count and a measure of the ledger platform's size if you can substantiate them. Then return to the reconciliation line and show what you did to reduce breaks and manual work.
